problems: Classification reuses public.london_daily_covers_base exactly (Website / Google Reserve / OpenTable / walk / reception CASE logic and its staff-name regex exclusion), with the 100-day window removed so the YoY week can be read. Its 'other' bucket is split for this report into ota = 'Thefork Integration' + 'First Table' and tp = everything else left in 'other'.

Metric = SUM(covers) by booking-created date (sr_created_at in Europe/London), is_deleted = false, status_simple <> 'Canceled', seating areas containing 'bar' excluded. The date predicate is written as a plain sargable range on sr_created_at, not a cast, and every query returned first time with no timeout.

Validation: 21-27 Sep recomputed on this basis = 11,416 covers against 11,696 published last week (-2.4%), with every venue equal to or slightly below last week's 'c': Aqua Shard 3,635 -> 3,538, Hutong 2,585 -> 2,500, Regent St 1,049 -> 1,009, Azzurra 692 -> 669, Shiro Sushi 793 -> 782, DSL 2,942 -> 2,918. That is normal settling as cancellations land after publication.
'other' key is a convenience rollup of walk+recep+ota+tp. Do NOT add it to the other buckets - it double counts.

Trend last value (W35 = 12,098) verified equal to the sum of cur covers across all six venue rows; trend ot last value (1,356) verified equal to the sum of cur 'ot'. W28 to W34 were re-pulled live and all sit at or slightly below last week's published values, again settling.

No bulk-import backfill was found in the London reporting week. Every single-hour entry of 60 covers or more is a staff-source row the view's regex already excludes: Aqua Shard 'David Dunlea' 180 covers on 28 Sep for a 26 Jan 2027 service date and a further 72 covers in three bookings, 'Lucy Dearman' 150 covers on 29 Sep for 9 Dec 2026, 'Ava Taylor' 60 covers on 1 Oct; Aqua Nueva 'Lucy Taylor' 70 covers on 29 Sep for 4 Dec 2026; Azzurra 'Maisie Brind' 70 covers on 2 Oct for 2 Dec 2026. All are forward-dated festive group bookings, none are past-dated, and none needed an adjustment. Aqua Shard staff covers rose 640 to 1,114 week on week on the back of them, entirely outside the reported total.

Two OT Guestcenter clusters at Dim Sum Library were checked and kept: 33 bookings for 92 covers in the 10:00 hour on 3 Oct and 25 bookings for 67 covers in the 10:00 hour on 4 Oct, maximum 7 covers per booking, service dates spread across 2 to 31 Oct. That is the normal OpenTable sync drip, not a past-dated data load.

True zeros, not fetch failures: Shiro Sushi recep is 0 in all three windows and its tp is 0 in all three; DSL ota is 0 in the current and prior week but 77 last year (TheFork and First Table volume that no longer exists); Azzurra tp is 0 in the current week and last year; Aqua Nueva recep is 0 in the current-year weeks where it reads 0.
